verdict.rationale: jo's docs say it can read existing decks and generate new ones from outlines, and can build and publish a website that you then change conversationally. That covers presentation creation and one iteratively edited artifact. However, general document creation, iterative editing of decks, and exporting files are never documented. missing for 10: document creation and editing, iterative editing of presentations, file export or download formats, independent or hands-on corroboration.
